Title: Info
Text:
When searching in array attributes with multiple query arguments joined by the AND operator, you want the records where:
* matching arguments are in the same element (new behavior)
 * matching arguments are in at least one element (existing behavior)

For this new behavior, if you want to only get records where matching arguments are in the same element, you need to link arguments. To link query arguments, add a letter between the [] in the first path to link and repeat the same letter in all linked arguments. (See Example 1)

QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person];[Person]OB_Field;"Children[a].Name";=;"Bob";*)
QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person]; & ;[Person]OB_Field;"Children[a].Age";=;"15")

To add different linked criteria in the same query, use another letter. (See Example 2)

QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person];[Person]OB_Field;"Children[a].Name";=;"Bob";*)
QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person]; & ;[Person]OB_Field;"Children[a].Age";=;"15";*)

QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person]; & ;[Person]OB_Field;"Children[b].Name";=;"Ann";*)
QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE([Person]; & ;[Person]OB_Field;"Children[b].Age";=;"9")

The impacted commands are:
* QUERY BY ATTRIBUTE
* QUERY SELECTION BY ATTRIBUTE
